propositions: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE environment variable must point to a TOML file whose keys layer over discovered config rather than replace it, maintaining per-key precedence
Configuration precedence order is: CLI -c llm.KEY > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config file > default
Deep/recursive merge applies to nested tables (leaf key wins) while arrays are replaced wholesale, never appended
Environment variable must be read as a string literal in os.environ.get() for static AST scanning by gen_env_registry.py to populate docs/env-vars.md
Pointing REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE to a nonexistent file must raise a typed rebar config error rather than silently fall back
